CheckTitle: CCE clusters run supported Kubernetes versions
Description: Ensure that CCE clusters are running Kubernetes versions at or above the minimum recommended version (1.25).
Risk: Running outdated Kubernetes versions exposes clusters to known vulnerabilities, missing security patches, and lack of support for modern security features.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Cloud Container Engine.
3. Select the cluster.
4. Upgrade the cluster to Kubernetes version 1.25 or later.

Recommendation.Text: Upgrade CCE clusters to Kubernetes version 1.25 or later.

Notes: Checks if CCE clusters are running Kubernetes versions below 1.25.
